name: codex-rpc
description: Manage Codex Discord Rich Presence on Windows: logo, active model and elapsed time.

interface.shortDescription: Show your Codex model in Discord
interface.longDescription: Install and manage the pinned Codex RPC tray runtime. Show the Codex logo, detected model and elapsed time. Usage is hidden by default; the upstream runtime can include the project folder name. Windows x64 only.
defaultPrompt: Enable Codex RPC in Discord with model and time.
